```python
import pytest
import click
import tempfile
import collections.abc as cabc
import contextlib
import io

from click.testing import CliRunner


def test_runner_catch_exceptions_default():
    @click.command()
    def cli_raises():
        raise ValueError("This is an error")

    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(cli_raises)
    assert result.exception is not None
    assert isinstance(result.exception, ValueError)


def test_runner_catch_exceptions_override_invoke():
    @click.command()
    def cli_raises():
        raise ValueError("This is an error")

    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(cli_raises, catch_exceptions=False)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="This is an error"):
        _ = result.exception


def test_runner_catch_exceptions_on_runner():
    @click.command()
    def cli_raises():
        raise ValueError("This is an error")

    # This test expects the bug to be present, so it will fail.
    # Once the bug is fixed, this test should pass.
    runner = CliRunner(catch_exceptions=False)
    result = runner.invoke(cli_raises)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="This is an error"):
        _ = result.exception

```
